cards.claim: The artist associated with the album "Familiar Stranger" is Bob Evans.
cards.quote: Familiar Stranger (Bob Evans album) Familiar Stranger is the fourth solo studio album by Australian indie pop artist, Kevin Mitchell, which was released on 15 March 2013 under his stage name, Bob Evans. It peaked at No. 31 on the ARIA Albums Chart. "Familiar Stranger" was produced by Dean Reid for EMI and provided two singles, "Don't Wanna Grow Up Anymore" (October 2012) and "Go" (February 2013). "Familiar Stranger" is the fourth solo album released on 15 March 2013 by Bob Evans, which is the stage name of Mitchell.
